scope: Broad India-related public discussion discovery, not a representative India population sample.
geography_policy: Hashtags and language never establish India geography. Panels are proposals until a human records audited_by, audited_at (timezone-aware), reference and status=human_audited. Panel evidence describes publisher relevance, not the location of authors or commenters.
panel_policy: Disabled proposed public accounts; verify handles, public status, India relevance and permissions before enabling. Runtime checks reject private or unknown accounts even if followed by the session.
budget_note: Includes one login method call and public-status lookups. Caps method calls and private request attempts separately. Library internals may issue extra requests. Server pages may exceed retained-item caps. Do not repeatedly run after blocking errors.

discovery.policy: Propose up to 20 new non-generic hashtags from captions published in the recent window and observed on recent/feed sources; retain supporting post IDs and domains. Allocate a proposed 25% of future seed slots to human-reviewed candidates, not automatic expansion. Server recent tabs can still be ranked.
